comparison.objective: Pipe a joined decorative shell border on a cake; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous bag-pressure control coordinated with nozzle motion and release to form repeated shells versus hex-tool insertion, collar adjustment, relocking, and physical testing.
comparison.success_condition: Distinct joined shells with ridges and tapered tails must span the marks without fouling the board; candidate requires quantified repeatable stopping behavior.
comparison.reason: Extrusion shaping and food-surface cleanliness share no meaningful tested mechanism with damper commissioning.
